To send notifications effectively, we utilize Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications. Our system checks the server's database daily to retrieve any new deadlines or events that have been added since the last check.

Each notification includes a clear and concise message, an urgent call-to-action button for immediate attention if necessary, and links to relevant resources within our app. Visual elements are used sparingly due to the high caution level.
